name: emet-mascot
description: A pixel mascot above the prompt that mirrors the session and the emet run phase.

size.title: Mascot size
size.description: small is 16 px (16 x 8 cells), medium is 24 px (24 x 12 cells).

showLabel.title: Show label
showLabel.description: Show the dim label beside the mascot, for example emet · wave 2 · review.
